name: DS15 Experimental Drone

name: Electro-static Flares
text: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save. While a friendly T'AU EMPIRE unit that is not a DEVILFISH is within 6 inches of the bearer, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch stratagem to shoot at it, and each ranged attack that targets it subtracts 1 from the hit roll.

effect.name: Electro-static Flares

effect.text: Friendly T'AU EMPIRE units (not DEVILFISH) within 6 inches of the bearer cannot be shot at with Fire Overwatch, and ranged attacks against them subtract 1 from the hit roll.

name: Prototype Systems
text: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save. Each time the bearer is selected to shoot, you may re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll made for its attacks, and you may re-roll the dice that set the Attacks of its airbursting fragmentation projector.

effect.name: Prototype Systems (wound)
